mapper.select:
select
from ord_dis_presale_activity where status = 'approved' and now() >= begin_sale_date and now() < end_sale_date and is_delete = 0

select
from ord_dis_presale_activity where status = 'executed' and now() >= end_sale_date and is_delete = 0

SELECT pa.id, pa.presale_image FROM ord_dis_presale_activity pa INNER JOIN ord_dis_presale_activity_store ps ON ps.presale_activity_id = pa.id WHERE pa.STATUS = 'executed' and pa.begin_sale_date <= now() and pa.end_sale_date > now() and ps.store_code = #{storeCode}

SELECT pa.id, pa.presale_activity_no, pa.STATUS, pa.total_goods_qty, pa.total_store_qty, pa.begin_sale_date, pa.end_sale_date, pa.begin_order_date, pa.end_order_date, pa.PROFILE, pa.presale_image, pa.is_limit_buy, pa.limit_buy_time, pa.promotional_price, pa.biz_org_code FROM ord_dis_presale_activity pa INNER JOIN ord_dis_presale_activity_store ps ON ps.presale_activity_id = pa.id WHERE pa.STATUS = 'executed' and pa.begin_sale_date <= now() and pa.end_sale_date > now() and ps.store_code = #{storeCode}
